Nate (CS): FYI AeroMed just flagged a few blockers in onboarding call. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Theyre pushing for fixes before contract review. Thoughts on prioritization?
Lina (CS): Top-line from the call: 
- Embeddings search returns policy docs for clinical queries (they expected device specs).
- Admins want role-based access to toggle routes and keys (current invites are clunky).
- Ingest: CSV import silently drops rows > 20k, customer lost 2 days.
Omar (PM): Thanks. From product POV: embeddings mismatch feels highest risk to adoption (P0). Admin UX and RBAC for routes is P1. Import robustness is P2 but painful.
Dev (ENG): Quick ask: can we get a sanitized failing sample and the exact model label used? Also any recent request ids?
Nate (CS): Sample we can share (sanitized):
```
{"text":"Ventilator calibration protocol v2","model":"open-similarity-2.0","metadata":{"customer":"aeromed-prod"}}
```
They said nearest neighbors were unrelated policy summaries. Example request id: aeromed-req-2026-06-07-447.
Lina (CS): Customer quote: "Search results are noise for our docs, makes the tool unusable for triage."
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-5032 and linked to ENG-2299.
Omar (PM): Proposed plan:
1) ENG triage (2d) to verify vectorization + model routing. Owner: Dev.
2) Product spec for RBAC/per-route keys (RFC next sprint).
3) CS to collect 2 more sanitized samples and repro steps.
Dev (ENG): I'll start repro now, will check tokenization, embedding drift across versions, and whether fallback model mapping is misrouted. Expect updates in 36-48h.
Nate (CS): I'll update AeroMed with a 48h triage ETA and collect more samples. Also scheduling a 30-min enablement session after we have mitigation.
Lina (CS): Adding note about renewal: finance wants this callout in the risk memo. If product wants to deprioritize RBAC, speak up now.
Omar (PM): I'm keeping RBAC on the backlog but moving embeddings triage to the top of next sprint if ENG confirms cause.
Nate (CS): Link to internal notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/aeromed-onboard-06-2026 (internal)
Dev (ENG): Posting initial findings shortly.
Nate (CS): Thanks team — will follow up once I have customer permission to share full logs. :thumbsup:
